column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 early seasonal / Courreges route (recovered)

column2: There's just something nice about spring flowers! They're pretty and $$可愛い$$...
Just looking at them makes me happy somehow.
When I wake up in the morning and see the morning glories blooming...
I can really feel that summer's come around!
This morning while I was jogging, I saw cosmos flowers blooming on top of the hill!
It's already... completely autumn, huh!
Even though it's already winter...
The yellow daffodils bloom, braving all this cold...
You can't help thinking what brave little flowers they are, right!?
Spring's coming on... Feels like sports season, doesn't it!
Morning jogs are getting to feel great this time of year!
I've gotta keep working hard at my $$リハビリ$$ today!
All right! I'm gonna sweat my way through the whole day today!
Gotta work hard from first thing in the morning!!
Morning! Feels like it's gonna get hot again today!!
Autumn means exercise... Moving your body from morning on feels so good, doesn't it?
Morning. It's getting cold, so... maybe we should start getting ready for winter?!
Mornin'!!
I'm not that great with winter, but we've gotta stay cheerful today!
Morning. Looks like it could snow today!
Winter sports aren't so bad, either...
It's hot again today, huh!!
Hey, if you feel like it... want to play in the water with me...?
Let's play in the water!
Let's not play in the water!
I'm so happy! To be able to talk to you like this again...
Ah...! Don't do that–
Hey, come on! That's my chest!
Don't tell me... you did that on purpose, did you?
A-a $$台風$$! We've gotta fix the leaky roof, fast!!
Sorry! I made you push yourself when you're just getting better...
But I'm really glad! That you're here...
...I'm really glad...
No, I'm fine. I'm not cold.
Just being with you makes me feel warm inside...
Why is that...?
I hope... you feel the same way too...
Huff... huff... Sorry for making you worry...
I-I think... I might have a fever... Huff... huff... huff...
Thanks for yesterday...!
You stayed with me all the way until morning...
Thanks... I think I'll be okay now...
But really... don't go outside alone again, okay!
Hehe! Do you know what day today is?
Do you remember?
Tadaaa!!
Here! Happy $$誕生日$$!!
Hey, hey, hey...!
This time I tried making a meat dish...!
Tadaaa!!
What do you think? Will you try it...?!
Huff... huff...
M-My stomach... it kind of... h-hurts...
Huff... huff...
I-I feel... kinda sick...
$$クレージュ$$ isn't here!!
A-Are you okay!?
You only woke up a week ago–are you up already!?
But don't push yourself. You don't seem fully better yet.
And I have... one important favor to ask you...
This is important, so I need you to never forget it!!
You've lost your $$記憶$$ of this $$世界$$...
You aren't used to what's normal in this $$世界$$ yet, right...?!
So until I can send you outside without worrying...
please don't go beyond the fence around the house alone...
For a while, we need to keep up your $$リハビリ$$!
Okay? Don't go outside on your own. Ever!!
It's a promise... just between us!!
Hey...
Do you remember what was special about today...?
